name: Ahead Health
description: Ahead Health is a Swiss-based, AI-driven preventive healthcare platform redefining medicine from reactive treatments to lifelong health management. By pairing hospital-grade whole-body MRI scans with advanced blood biomarkers, Ahead translates complex health data into a continuous, physician-supervised timeline of actionable insights. Built on an asset-light, highly scalable model, Ahead partners directly with local radiology networks and clinical experts across Europe to deliver rigorous, trusted, and proactive care years before symptoms appear.

name: Ordio
description: Born out of the day-to-day chaos in a fast-growing sushi restaurant chain, Ordio simplifies and enhances workforce management for the frontline services industry. Ordio combines everything managers and employees need to coordinate daily work in one scalable platform. Deskless teams use Ordio to organize shifts, track working hours, manage operations, and communicate seamlessly. With Payroll Plus, Ordio offers AI-powered net payroll processing tailored to the complexity of shift-based pay structures. Trusted by over 1,500 companies to plan millions of shifts, Ordio replaces fragmented tools and manual processes with a solution built for the complexity of deskless work.

name: Emmi AI
description: Emmi AI is an innovator at the intersection of artificial intelligence and physics. They develop universally applicable, AI-driven physics simulation models that transform engineering and manufacturing across industries including aviation, energy, semiconductors, automotive, and chemicals. Traditional simulation methods are slow, expensive and require heavy computational investment. In contrast, Emmi AI’s breakthrough AI-driven simulation models dramatically increase simulation speed, streamline production planning and enable new ways for design optimization, making industrial-scale engineering more efficient and cost-effective.

name: Stelia
description: Stelia is a globally distributed compute platform that abstracts AI workloads from specific GPUs and locations, intelligently allocating resources – from pre-training to edge inference – enabling AI to scale and deliver impact worldwide.

name: fundcraft
description: Fundcraft streamlines alternative investment management with an all-in-one digital platform that boosts transparency, efficiency, and compliance. The platform centralizes and automates fund administration, offering a comprehensive solution for regulatory requirements, reporting, portfolio management, and investor engagement. fundcraft is the single source of truth for all stakeholders throughout the entire investment lifecycle.

name: Fynk
description: fynk is a leading AI-powered contract management software. Fynk was born out of frustration. While working at their previous company, the founders realized that managing contracts had become a serious bottleneck for sales and marketing teams. Drafting personalized contracts, getting them approved, and collecting signatures was time-consuming, often leading to delays and mistakes—leaving customers dissatisfied. This personal pain point sparked the idea for fynk. In November 2021, during a trip to the Italian Dolomites, the founders began developing what would become a revolutionary platform. With AI at its core, fynk simplifies contract drafting, review, and management, helping teams streamline their processes, reduce errors, and close deals faster. Today, fynk is on a mission to become the world’s leading platform for contract management and automation, empowering businesses to stay ahead in a fast-paced digital world.

name: simpleclub
description: simpleclub is a leading AI-powered all-in-one learning platform for vocational training. simpleclub provides a modern educational platform to bridge the shortage of trainers in companies and vocational teachers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. These challenges will increase in an aging society. simpleclub's solution directly tackles this issue by providing both a platform loved by trainers for it increases their efficiency and better access to education for aspiring trainees, which, in turn, translates into a better qualified workforce. Starting as a Youtube channel, simpleclub has evolved into a successful B2C platform with over 2 million users. Their recent entry to the B2B market has been highly successful, over 300 corporate partners and significant revenue growth in just two years.

name: The Brief
description: The Brief is an AI agency in your browser. The Brief helps you discover insights, generate creatives, launch everywhere, and optimize results, continuously. Even if nowadays designers and marketers are spoiled with choice in terms of tooling, to scale and deliver creative efforts across channels remains a challenge. Although there are makeshift solutions, the existing processes are often disjointed. We invested in The Brief because we believe that the leadership are a perfect team-industry fit. Their extensive advertising and creative expertise and passion to deliver value to their customers create a unique opportunity in a market exceeding $140 billion. The Brief is on a path to become a leader in the creative automation sector and we're thrilled to support them on this transformative journey.

name: Circeus
description: Circeus is the AI-native holding company for mission-critical software, acquiring and evolving the software businesses that power the everyday economy. Building an online store has never been easier thanks to platforms like Shopify. Whilst setting up a store is now relatively simple, growing it is a challenge. Merchants understand that reaching as many customers as possible, while maintaining a great customer experience is something that requires a lot of help. Fortunately for them, help is available in the form of thousands of apps that solve specific headaches, such as marketing automation, customer feedback, analytics or payment reconciliation. We think Circeus is positioning itself to become an important player in shaping the future of eCommerce. The ultimate goal is to give merchants the tools to succeed and scale their online business, we couldn’t be more excited than to pursue it together with Luca and Gian and the rest of the Circeus team.
funding_notes: Holding company of Shop Circle, renamed Circeus in Jun 2026. The company says it has raised more than $120M in equity and more than $220M of total capital, including a $100M+ credit facility from i80 Group. The Shop Circle 'Series A' (Sep 2023) was $120M of mixed equity and debt; its equity share wasn't disclosed. The EBRD-led equity round (Jun 2026) was also undisclosed. amount_raised is the company's 'more than $120M' equity figure. It has made 18 acquisitions.

name: Pactum
description: Pactum helps global companies to digitally conduct personalized commercial negotiations on a massive scale. Pactum works with $5B-plus revenue companies, including many top Fortune 500 organizations such as Walmart and Maersk. Pactum’s solution creates a fast and responsive environment for users to digitally negotiate deals with thousands of suppliers at a time, leading to productivity gains, cost-reductions and stronger terms for all parties. On average, Pactum generates savings of 3%-5% when fully deployed by enterprise clients, creating hundreds of millions of dollars in unrealized savings. While Pactum is currently focused on agreements with suppliers, it’s easy to see where this technology could go next. How about using AI to help employers and employees negotiate employment contracts based on their unique requirements?

name: Avi Medical
description: AVI Medical provides better care and service to patients by fundamentally fixing how primary care is done. Creating a whole new patient experience at the doctor’s office. Delivering the best possible medical care. Integrating state-of-the-art digital tools. All with a human touch: Avi Medical is building patient-centric, technology-enabled medical practices that deliver an unprecedented convenient, personalized and holistic digital patient experience. “We have seen a lot of companies trying to sell software solutions (ranging from practice management solutions to diagnostics) to physicians. It is really hard and rarely scales, even though the solutions would often contribute to better outcomes and more accessible healthcare. We got really excited when Vlad told us that AVI Medical is rebuilding primary care from scratch by opening its own practices and using software to enhance the experience for patients and doctors. AVI Medical brings primary healthcare into the 21st century.” -- Eva Arh, Partner 3VC joins existing investors Picus Capital, Vorwerk Ventures, Nat Turner and Zach Weinberg (Founders of Flatiron Health), and Daniel Dines (Founder of UiPath) in the 28.5 million euro Series A round led by Addition and Heal Capital.

name: Picsart
description: Picsart is the world’s largest creative platform and community with more than 100 million monthly active users and influencers. Every month, the Picsart community creates, remixes and shares nearly 1 billion images and videos, making it the largest open source collection of content in the world with free to edit photos, stickers, filters, and more. Picsart is available in 30 languages for free and as a subscription on iOS, Android and Windows devices. Headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Yerevan, Armenia; Los Angeles; Beijing; and an AI lab in Moscow. We invested in Picsart's Series A round in July 2019. Co-Investors include Sequoia Capital and Insight Partners.

name: Lokalise
description: Lokalise is the leading localization and translation management platform for agile teams. It embraces automation, workflow transparency, and fast project delivery. In their own words, "Lokalise is on a mission to eliminate the hassle of localization - the process of adapting and translating digital content to local markets - by providing a platform to automate, integrate, and better manage translations of digital content into multiple languages: because localisation removes borders and leads to more growth." We are proud and excited to partner up with the Lokalise team in making localization effortless in a strong setup with Chalfen Ventures by the experienced B2B software investor Mike Chalfen and high-profile angel investors including Andrey Khusid (Founder and CEO of Miro ), Nicolas Dessaigne (Co-Founder of Algolia ) and Des Traynor (Co-Founder and CSO of Intercom ).

name: Storyblok
description: Storyblok is an Austrian based startup that offers a SaaS Content Management System with an API-first approach for developers. Storyblok provides content creators with an intuitive management interface that has the experience of a page-builder. Content is completely separate from the presentation layer and can be used across different channels. Storyblok was started and founded in 2017 by Alexander Feiglstorfer and Dominik Angerer during their joint work at Netural in Linz. We invested in Storyblok's Seed round in December 2019. Co-Investors include Firstminute Capital.
funding_notes: $138M total raised, per the company at its Series C: $8.5M Series A (2021), $47M Series B (2022) and $80M Series C led by Brighton Park (Jun 2024). Headless CMS based in Linz, Austria. The listed rounds add up to $135.5M; the rest is earlier seed money.

name: Aloqia
description: Aloqia enables companies to take action on excess inventory by reusing, reselling, and recycling deadstock through one-of-a-kind climate fintech software. name: Atlantic Sea Farms
description: Atlantic Sea Farms produces innovative, fresh sea vegetable products under the brand name Atlantic Sea Farms . Their products are never dried or dyed and are farmed by independent lobstermen in the clean cold waters of Maine. Seaweed farming improves water quality, produces a food high in essential vitamins and minerals, and creates a supplemental income source for Maine’s fishermen. Atlantic Sea Farms is the first to market with a fresh, domestic sea vegetable product and their easy-to-use products make kelp approachable and delicious.

name: BrainCheck
description: BrainCheck provides rapid, mobile cognitive assessment tools and personalized cognitive care planning. Assessments take about 10 minutes, can be performed anywhere, and deliver results on the spot. The system also provides clinical decision support to physicians, allowing them to provide cognitive health education, remote monitoring, and personalized cognitive care management. They are an FDA Class II Medical Device and reimbursable by insurance.

name: Dalinea
description: Dalinea is a procurement intelligence platform purpose-built for visibility, forecasting, and impact— down to the SKU level. Designed by procurement professionals, it empowers teams to anticipate tariff shifts, counter supplier price hikes, and integrate carbon data into sourcing decisions. Dalinea transforms procurement from reactive to strategic by surfacing the real drivers of cost and risk— enabling smarter negotiations, more resilient supply chains, and measurable bottom-line results.

name: De Oro Devices
description: De Oro Devices makes mobility assistive devices to allow people with mobility disorders to walk confidently and safely. Their beachhead market is in Parkinson’s Disease where they help overcome freezing of gait, one of the most common and most debilitating symptoms of Parkinson’s. De Oro’s initial patent-pending device, NexStride, combines a green laser line visual cue and a metronome auditory cue into a small portable device that can attach to any cane, walker, or walking pole.

name: Dermala
description: Dermala utilizes the human microbiome to develop the next generation of OTC dermatology treatments for the most prevalent skin diseases and conditions, such as acne, eczema and aging. Backed by IP exclusively licensed from a university as well as independently developed, Dermala uses prebiotic and probiotic formulations to improve skin health naturally. Leveraging a technology-driven mobile app solution, Dermala delivers personalized treatments to further optimize outcomes.

name: Flourish
description: Flourish helps women get healthy for good by teaching their members to build sustainable habits across the full spectrum of behavioral health: nutrition, hydration, sleep, stress, relationships, and movement. Flourish incorporates gold standard practices that were previously only available through meeting one-on-one and often in-person with a registered dietitian or therapist. Flourish delivers virtually and at scale through a subscription membership offering personalized coaching from credentialed health experts, community support, and evidence-based education.

name: Flowly
description: Flowly is a mobile platform for chronic pain and anxiety. Flowly teaches you to control your heart rate and breathing so that you can better manage your nervous system. Flowly takes you from a state of pain, anxiety, or stress, and transitions you into a state of Flow: relaxed yet focused. All experiences can be accessed just on the phone or in Virtual Reality. Flowly also includes an in-app community where users can share resources and experiences.

name: Fort Health
description: Fort Health is a virtual mental health platform providing fast, accessible care for children and adolescents. By leveraging teletherapy and collaborating with leading institutions like the Child Mind Institute, Fort Health offers evidence-based treatment, including therapy and medication management. Their model eliminates traditional barriers, offering families convenient access to top mental health professionals while prioritizing measurable outcomes and personalized care plans to improve youth mental well-being.

name: Jiminy’s
description: By thinking differently about the protein source in our pet’s food, Jiminy’s created a better dog food that delivers enormous benefit. Jiminy’s makes delicious, sustainable, insect-based dog food and treats that nourish pets and promote long-term stewardship of the earth. Jiminy’s has made a commitment to fighting climate change, and with their products they’ve made it easy for pet parents to make an eco-friendly choice for their furry kids.

name: Oralucent
description: Oralucent is the world’s most effective toothbrush and is set to revolutionize oral care. The patented sonic toothbrush emits a type of blue light that is proven to whiten teeth and eradicate harmful bacteria that cause plaque, gum disease, and bad breath. The class 1 medical device overcomes limitations of the mechanical toothbrush by cleaning hard to reach locations between the teeth and below the gum line with no change in brushing habits.

name: Ovum Health
description: Ovum Health is the exclusive lifestyle medicine provider for pre-pregnancy and pre-IVF care, delivering medically supervised programs that improve health and fertility outcomes and reduce costly interventions. By embedding directly within IVF clinics and partnering with employers, Ovum becomes the first step before treatment. Ovum’s data-driven approach drives higher pregnancy rates, lowers healthcare costs, and addresses root causes of infertility—positioning Ovum as critical infrastructure in the fertility care continuum.

name: Partum Health
description: Partum Health is a digital care company working to radically improve the health of women and families, starting with fertility, pregnancy, and early family life. Partum’s care model brings together experts including perinatal mental health providers, physical therapists, birth doulas, postpartum doulas, lactation consultants and more. Families get the best of online and offline care including digital care coordination, telehealth and in person care to comprehensively prevent complications and address their full range of health needs.

name: Point Health
description: PointHealth is a clinical AI platform embedded directly within electronic health records (EHRs) that helps clinicians make more precise treatment decisions, starting with behavioral health. Today, only 30–40% of patients respond to their first prescribed medication for depression, leading to prolonged suffering, unnecessary side effects, and increased costs. PointHealth doubles the success of prescriptions by using AI to compare each patient to millions of similar patient journeys and recommend treatments based on real-world outcomes.

name: Refiberd
description: Over 186 billion pounds of textile waste are generated each year, and less than 1% is recycled into new clothing. Refiberd is solving this global textile waste crisis through their patent-pending system that can process post-consumer waste into brand new textile products. Refiberd’s textile recycling system has two stages: 1) an AI and robotics-based system which sorts discarded textiles by material and color, and 2) an eco-friendly chemical textile recycling process which converts the sorted textiles into new Refiberd thread.

name: reHarvest
description: reHarvest crafts frozen smoothie products that do good. reHarvest delivers tasty and nutrient-dense smoothies that radically tackle food loss via their commitment to reHARVEST and rePURPOSE unnecessarily discarded produce. All products are formulated with clean and functional ingredients that do good for your body and the world around you. reHarvest also incorporates innovative packaging solutions that allow their products to be shipped at ambient temperature, avoiding environmental impacts and costs of a cold supply chain.

name: Rosy
description: Designed by doctors and psychologists, Rosy creates solutions to empower women on their journey to sexual wellness. Rosy’s novel mobile platform offers an evidence-based, holistic approach to sexual health including education, behavioral interventions, community, and personalized support, and it’s now recommended by more than 3500 healthcare professionals for sexual health concerns. In a recent study, Rosy users experienced a statistically significant improvement in multiple aspects of sexual function including desire, arousal, orgasm and pain.

name: RubyWell
description: RubyWell helps family caregivers in the “Missing Middle” get certified as home health aides, and paid for providing care to aging loved ones who are eligible for home health benefits through Medicare. Compatible across all Li-ion cathode materials, our platform provides extensibility across current Li-ion batteries and sustains performance for next generation cathode designs as well.

By indexing real-time clickstream behavior from devices and web activity, Behavix replaces traditional surveys with empirical data, empowering organizations to make data-driven decisions with precision and scale.

name: Bookboost
description: Bookboost is a modern CRM and guest communication platform built for hospitality teams. It consolidates guest data across PMS, OTAs, messaging channels, and loyalty programs. Features include a unified inbox, automated guest journeys, segmentation, campaigns, chatbots, and reporting dashboards. The platform powers more personalized communication, improves team efficiency, increases revenue, and elevates loyalty – all with minimal setup and no spreadsheets required.

name: Brella
description: Brella is an all-in-one event platform for virtual, hybrid, and in-person formats. It uses AI-powered matchmaking, a customizable event app, and robust analytics to drive meaningful engagement between attendees and sponsors. The platform centralizes ticketing, registration, networking, scheduling, and sponsor tools within a branded mobile and web experience, helping organizers prove ROI, boost repeat attendance, and simplify event logistics.

name: Claimlane
description: Claimlane is a platform that helps retailers, brands, and suppliers manage product returns and warranty claims more efficiently. It provides a unified, self-service portal where customers can submit return requests with all required documentation. Internal teams handle claims via automated workflows, integrated with e-commerce, helpdesk, ERP, and logistics systems. The system gathers insights on return reasons and product defects, helping organizations reduce manual work and streamline operations while improving customer experience.

name: Cluby
description: Cluby is an all-in-one marketing and loyalty platform built specifically for restaurants, cafes, and nightclubs. It enables businesses to create a digital customer register, offer exclusive membership benefits, and engage directly with guests through push notifications, in-app messages, and digital staff or VIP cards. The platform supports ticket sales, events, and subscription passes, all managed through one app, to drive repeat visits, boost average spend, and foster long-term loyalty across venues.

name: Eyeball
description: Eyeball.Club is an AI-powered scouting platform built for youth football. It digitizes talent identification using a vast video database, AI computer vision, and performance analytics to help professional clubs, scouts, and academies discover emerging players across Europe, Africa, and beyond. The platform offers full-match footage, thousands of tagged player stats, and scout-ready profiles all accessible via analytics tools. Used by over 100 top clubs, including Premier League, Bundesliga, Serie A, and Ajax, Eyeball reduces reliance on luck and travel by making hidden talent visible and actionable for recruitment teams worldwide.

name: ezy insights
description: EzyInsights is a real-time content discovery and media monitoring platform designed primarily for newsrooms, publishers, and digital media teams. The platform tracks millions of stories and social media shares daily, identifies high-performing content and emerging trends, and benchmarks engagement against competitors. It offers fast alerts, performance dashboards, timing recommendations, and content heatmaps to help editorial teams publish smarter and grow audience reach. Trusted by leading media organizations across Europe and beyond, EzyInsights delivers actionable insights that boost traffic and overall content impact.

name: GBuilder
description: GBuilder is a BIM-based Customer Journey Management platform built for real estate developers and construction companies. It integrates everything from sales, marketing, and design configuration to construction execution, digital handovers, and aftercare in one digital ecosystem. With features like interactive 3D visualisation, material configurator, centralized communication, and real-time data access, GBuilder improves efficiency, reduces errors and waste, and boosts upsells and customer satisfaction across large residential and commercial projects in over a dozen countries.

name: Giosg
description: Giosg is a conversational engagement platform that helps organizations turn website visitors into customers using a mix of AI chatbots, live chat, video calls, and interactive content. It combines real-time visitor tracking, proactive messaging, visitor scoring, and shoppable video tools to guide users toward conversion. Trusted by over 1,200 companies globally, Giosg supports sales, marketing, and customer service functions by automating up to 60% of routine queries and generating more qualified leads across industries such as retail, automotive, and telecom.

name: Happeo
description: Happeo is an AI-powered intranet and digital workplace that combines structured knowledge pages, live collaboration channels, and federated search across tools like Google Workspace and Slack – all in one hub. With drag-and-drop customization, analytics, and deep Google/Microsoft integration, it boosts engagement, knowledge sharing, and productivity in modern organizations.

name: HappySignals
description: HappySignals is an IT Experience Management (ITXM™) platform that helps IT teams measure and improve employee satisfaction and productivity. It integrates continuous feedback with tools like ServiceNow and Jira, offering real-time dashboards, analytics, and built-in XLAs to identify and fix experience gaps. By aligning technical and non-technical teams, HappySignals drives measurable service improvements and better digital experiences across global organizations.

name: Hopsworks
description: Hopsworks is an enterprise AI Lakehouse platform that unifies feature store, model registry, real-time serving, vector search, and governance in one place. It minimizes integration effort by bundling key MLOps components –like orchestration, monitoring, and secure access – so teams can focus on building and deploying models. Hopsworks supports batch, real-time, and LLM workloads across any infrastructure, with sub-millisecond latency via its RonDB online store.

name: Hostaway
description: Hostaway is an all-in-one platform for vacation rental managers, offering tools like property management, channel distribution, messaging, automation, and analytics. It syncs listings across Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com and more, helping hosts scale from a few to thousands of properties. With features like dynamic pricing and direct booking support, Hostaway streamlines operations and boosts revenue.

name: Inven
description: Inven is an AI-powered deal sourcing and market intelligence platform designed for M&A professionals, private equity firms, investment banks, and consultants. It analyzes data on over 21 million companies from millions of websites, news articles, and registers using NLP and predictive models. Users simply describe or point to a target company and Inven returns a refined list of potential matches – complete with ownership, financials, growth trends, intent-to-sell signals, and verified contact data. The platform helps users identify acquisition targets, investors, or industry peers up to ten times faster than traditional research methods and is trusted by over 700 firms globally.

name: Leadfeeder
description: Leadfeeder is a B2B intent-data platform that turns anonymous website visitors into actionable sales leads by identifying companies via IP analytics, tracking their browsing behavior, and enriching profiles with firmographic and contact data. It offers more than basic analytics – with filters, scoring, and real-time alerts, it surfaces high‑intent prospects. Seamless integrations with CRMs and tools like Pipedrive, HubSpot, and Slack let teams act fast, focus on qualified leads, and convert visitors missed by traditional forms.

name: Mazepay
description: Mazepay is a Danish fintech‑powered SaaS that modernizes long-tail B2B procurement and payments for mid- to large-sized enterprises. The platform issues single-use virtual cards for individual purchases only after approval, automates receipt collection and purchase orders, enforces custom multi-level workflows, and provides a full audit trail. Integrated with Mastercard’s ICCP system and leading European banks, Mazepay simplifies indirect spend management across 21 countries and minimizes manual work for finance and procurement teams.

name: Medixine
description: Medixine offers an easy-to-use digital healthcare platform that helps doctors and nurses care for patients remotely. With Medixine Suite, healthcare teams can monitor patients’ vital signs like blood pressure and oxygen levels from home, send messages, run video calls, and collect health updates through online forms. It’s used to support people with long-term conditions like heart disease or diabetes. By using Medixine, healthcare providers save time, reduce paperwork, and give patients better care without needing as many in-person visits.

name: mepin
description: MePIN was a Finland‑based mobile authentication platform designed to bring banking-grade security and seamless user experience to online services. The platform used strong Public Key Infrastructure based authentication and optional biometric or PIN verification to authorize logins and payments with cryptographic challenge-response. MePIN reduced user friction while ensuring compliance with standards like FIDO and PCI, and deployed in under 30 minutes in cloud or hybrid environments for enterprise and fintech customers.

name: myPlane
description: myPlane is a digital B2B platform that revolutionizes charter flight booking by connecting airlines and travel buyers in real time. It enables sourcing, booking, sales, and operations management of group charter flights directly from over 150 major airlines. Using AI-powered workflows, myPlane modernizes traditional charter processes, increases transparency, efficiency, and pricing control while eliminating manual overhead across global markets. Travel agencies, tour operators, charter brokers, and airlines use the platform to streamline procurement, manage fleet operations centrally, and unlock revenue from excess capacity.

name: MyTelescope
description: MyTelescope is an AI-powered market intelligence platform built around Share of Search analytics. It tracks billions of search queries across Google, YouTube, Bing, Amazon, and social media to uncover brand interest, emerging trends, and demand signals with high predictive accuracy. Users can build customizable dashboards to monitor brand health, compare competitors, spot opportunities, and forecast performance in near real time – turning public search behavior into actionable insights for marketing, strategy, and research teams.

name: PatentRenewal
description: PatentRenewal.com is an IP renewal platform that lets patent, trademark, design, and utility-model holders automate their renewal process across 230+ jurisdictions. With its intuitive dashboard, verified IP data, real-time tracking, watch-style status updates, budgeting and forecasting tools, and transparent pricing, the platform ensures accuracy and control while reducing renewal costs by up to 50% compared to traditional renewal providers.

name: Sumo
description: Suite of creative tools

name: Surveypal
description: SurveyPal is a cloud-based feedback platform that helps companies collect, understand, and act on opinions from customers or employees. It offers easy-to-build surveys, smart AI analysis of open-ended responses, and real-time tracking of metrics like NPS and CSAT – all in one dashboard. Whether via email, in-app, or embedded surveys, SurveyPal ensures feedback from everywhere is gathered and turned into insights that teams can use to improve service and strategy in real time.

name: Syncle
description: Syncle (previously Videoly) is a smart product‑content platform that automates the formatting, organization, and syndication of all product assets – images, videos, specs, etc. – tailored for e‑commerce workflows, minimizing manual steps and checklists. It enables brands to upload once and systematically distribute clean, compliant content across retailers, while providing full visibility into delivery and performance.

name: Trustmary
description: Trustmary is a platform that helps businesses collect, analyze, and showcase customer feedback and reviews in one place. Using a patented “3‑in‑1” survey, it gathers satisfaction scores, open feedback, and reviews across text, video, and third-party sources – automatically and at scale. The platform includes AI tools to surface insights and highlight top testimonials, customizable widgets to show reviews on web and social channels, and CRM integrations to automate workflows and lead generation. Used by service businesses in over 100 countries, Trustmary aims to help companies build credibility and improve customer engagement by turning feedback into structured business value.

name: Uploadcare
description: Uploadcare is a developer-first file management platform offering secure and scalable file upload, storage, processing, transformation, optimization, and delivery via CDN. It supports multiple upload sources and large files, includes built-in image and video editing, malware detection, signed upload controls, and automatic format optimization via a global Smart CDN. This streamlined toolkit significantly cuts integration time and helps improve page load speeds and conversion rates for media-heavy apps.

name: Utopia Analytics
description: Utopia Analytics offers AI-powered text analytics and content moderation tools that turn user‑generated content into business value. Its Utopia AI Text Analytics Platform automates classification, clustering, sentiment analysis, semantic search, and trend detection across any language or dialect. It also delivers a real‑time content moderation solution for text, images, audio, and video, accurately filtering harmful content at scale – supported by customizable models, up to 99.9% automation, and fast integration via API in just two weeks.

name: Vividworks
description: VividWorks is a Finnish 3D product configuration and visual CPQ platform designed for retailers, manufacturers, and furniture brands. It allows customers to customize products in real time with interactive 3D and AR visualization. The platform handles complex modular product logic, real‑time quoting, bill-of-material generation, and seamless integration with eCommerce, ERP, and CRM systems. Clients report faster sales cycles, higher conversions, and fewer order errors by enabling customers to visually design their purchases before checkout.

name: Woomio
description: Woomio is an influencer marketing platform used by brands and agencies to discover creators, manage campaigns, and track performance. It powers full influencer programs: searching and vetting creators, automating workflows, predicting campaign impact, and measuring ROI with rich analytics. Trusted across the Nordics and serving agencies that work with KOLs globally, Woomio enables marketers to launch, optimize, and report on influencer collaborations with transparency and speed.

name: Xolo
description: Xolo is a full-service business platform for freelancers and solopreneurs, offering tools like global invoicing, bank payments, bookkeeping, tax compliance, and company formation (including support for Estonian e‑Residency). With localized solutions in countries such as Spain, Netherlands, Italy, and Germany, it simplifies admin so solopreneurs can focus on their work and growth, backed by expert accounting support and seamless integration with Stripe, PayPal, Revolut, and more.

name: Zoined
description: Zoined provides a reporting and analytics platform for businesses in retail, hospitality, restaurants, and wholesale. It connects to systems such as point-of-sale, inventory, and finance to consolidate data into dashboards and scheduled reports. The platform helps users track performance, compare locations, and review trends without requiring technical expertise. Store managers, operations teams, and business analysts use Zoined to support day-to-day decision making with structured data views.

description: Hilo has developed clinically validated software algorithms that enable continuous blood pressure measurement via optical sensors worn at the wrist. Hilo’s breakthrough technology is validated through extensive trials, endorsed by leading physicians and engages consumers with timely, actionable insights, while enabling healthcare providers to deliver more personalized care.

name: Alaya
description: Alaya’s Employee Purpose platform empowers companies to build a purpose-driven culture and engage employees while acting on today’s social and environmental challenges. Alaya serves major companies across the world. Alaya offers a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) model. Companies license Alaya’s digital platform to easily manage their purpose-driven employee engagement programs, through positive actions such as volunteering, giving, wellbeing and sustainability.

name: Andjaro
description: Andjaro is a dynamic workforce management solution to reallocate workforce in real-time. It ensure business continuity in spite of the ever-changing circumstances and allows companies to respond rapidly to unpredictable employee availability (absenteeism, sickness, child care, etc) and adapt to highly fluctuating customer demand. As of 2020, Andjaro operates 250,000 staff transfers per year and has already generated EUR 20 million in savings on its clients’ temporary and fixed-term contracts budgets.

name: ANYbotics
description: ANYbotics has developed a robotic workforce to automate inspection and maintenance tasks in harsh, hazardous and complex environments and allows clients to reliably and frequently collect better data. ANYbotics offers two inspection systems: ANYmal and ANYmal X. Both are industrial-grade and safety-certified water and dust-proof autonomous robots. ANYmal X is the world’s only legged robot with Ex-certification, which means that the robot can be safely used in explosive atmospheres such as the majority of all oil & gas and chemical plants.

name: Artiria Medical
description: Artiria Medical is a Swiss medtech innovator revolutionizing the treatment of stroke and other neurovascular conditions. The company’s core technology features a micromanipulable guidewire that allows surgeons to navigate the brain’s complex arterial network with unprecedented speed and precision. By minimizing the time and risks associated with traditional catheterization, Artiria aims to significantly improve clinical outcomes for patients in critical need.

name: Atana
description: The company was founded in late 2025 as a strategic spin-out from Lilac Solutions, a scale-up backed by Bill Gates’ Breakthrough Energy and Chris Sacca’s Lowercarbon Capital, and a global leader in direct lithium extraction (DLE). Atana utilizes an AI-powered platform to accelerate the exploration of fluid-based assets—specifically lithium brines, dissolved minerals, gases (H2, He), and geothermal heat. Traditional mining is characterized by slow development and high capital intensity. Atana addresses these hurdles, having built a comprehensive global dataset, digitizing previously scattered and unstructured geological data, and applying petroleum petrophysics and computational fluid dynamics to the mineral sector. This allows them to identify previously overlooked mineral sweet spots and validate these resources in approximately 22 months – significantly faster (and at much lower cost) than the industry standard of 3 to 5 years. Atana operates a capital-light, vertically integrated model. They identify and secure overlooked land, de-risk the resource using their technology stack, and then sell or Joint Venture (JV) with major operators (e.g., ExxonMobil, Rio Tinto) while retaining 1–3% production royalties and carried interest.

name: Avrios
description: The Avrios Business Intelligence Platform helps operators of commercial vehicles utilize their assets as efficient as possible. Applying the latest research in machine learning, Avrios helps them automatically extract valuable and actionable business insights from the data they already have.

name: Axelera AI
description: Axelera is developing a novel hardware and software platform for AI that processes data right where it is generated. In traditional hardware architectures the central processing units (CPUs) and memory chips are separate, but Axelera’s core technology combines the two. By putting the computing power in the memory chip itself, the time- and energy-intensive data movements between the cloud and the end device are eliminated, making the computations faster and 10 times more energy efficient than standard digital computing.

name: Axiom Therapeutics
description: Axiom Therapeutics is an early-stage startup founded by two PhDs from the University of Cambridge with backgrounds in Computational Chemistry and drug discovery. It aims to build a computational platform that helps pharmaceutical companies discover and develop new covalent drugs. This vision has the potential to transform the pharmaceutical industry. Axiom’s approach can revolutionize the discovery process of new covalent drugs. Its breadth (millions of drugs against a few thousand used today) and speed could allow pharma partners to exceed what they can do in the wet lab today.

name: Aylight
description: Aylight is a Zurich-based company that spun out of ETH in October 2025. They have developed a new, patented laser platform called a “quantum walk comb laser”, which drastically increases the number of channels – or colours – that can be used for WDM. The new laser relies on high-order physical processes to generate a very stable and tunable output spectrum from a single laser cavity. This greatly eases manufacturing, resulting in a much lower cost per unit compared to the current standard. On top of this, the platform already demonstrated best-in-class performance when it comes to noise – one of the main inhibitors to adoption for other new platforms.

name: Bcomp
description: Bcomp is the leading solutions provider for natural fibre reinforcements in high performance applications from race to space. The company started as a garage project in 2011 with a mission to create lightweight yet high performance skis. The bCores™ were launched and successfully adopted by some of the biggest names in freeride skiing. The founders, material science PhDs from EPFL, used flax fibres to reinforce the balsa cores and improve shear stiffness. Impressed by the excellent mechanical properties of flax fibres, the development to create sustainable lightweighting solutions for the wider mobility markets started. Today, Bcomp is a leader in natural fibre composites for sustainable lightweighting. Our solutions are found from sports and motorsports to automotive interiors, luxury sailing yachts, bridges and satellite panels.

name: Beekeeper
description: Beekeeper is a mobile communication platform for companies that empowers, informs, and connects their frontline workers. More than 1’000 companies in 150 countries rely on Beekeeper’s productivity tool to connect to more than 1’000’000 employees. The app conforms to data protection standards and integrates applications by other providers. The coronavirus crisis has accentuated companies’ need to stay in touch with employees and accelerated Beekeeper’s sales cycle.
